title: Taskflow Agent finds SQL injection in Zammad API
summary: Zammad 6.5.2 interpolates an unvalidated block-level operator into SQL in selector-based API search, allowing a low-privilege customer to extract sensitive database records.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its Taskflow Agent and manual verification by Peter Stöckli and Man Yue Mo. Reported 2026-02-17; Zammad released the patch in v7.0.0 on 2026-03-04. No CVE was assigned in the cited evidence.
classification_note: The advisory documents the finding and its disclosure/remediation state. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in Zammad 7.0.0; vendor advisory ZAA-2026-06 also lists 6.5.3 as fixed.
